lessonTitle: 30. Number of elements in a union
lessonTitleEnglish: Number of elements in a union
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Let n(A) be the number of elements of a finite set A. If A and B share no elements, n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B).
stages.headlineEnglish: Let n(A) be the number of elements of a finite set A. If A and B share no elements, n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B).

stages.headline: If they share elements, those are counted twice, so subtract them once: n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B).
stages.headlineEnglish: If they share elements, those are counted twice, so subtract them once: n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B).

stages.headline: A class of 30: 18 like maths, 15 like physics, 7 like both. How many like neither?
stages.headlineEnglish: A class of 30: 18 like maths, 15 like physics, 7 like both. How many like neither?

stages.headline: n(A) = 12, n(B) = 9, n(A ∩ B) = 5. Find n(A ∪ B).
